traditions.VUL: et in lege , et in præcéptis , et in testimóniis eius non ambulavéritis :
traditions.KJV: nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies ;

23.english_reference: therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֥את אֶתְ כֶ֛ם הָ רָעָ֥ה הַ זֹּ֖את כַּ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.VUL: idcírco evenérunt vobis mala hæc , sicut est dies hæc .
traditions.KJV: therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .

24.english_reference: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people , and to all the women

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶל כָּל הָ עָ֔ם וְ אֶ֖ל כָּל הַ נָּשִׁ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Dixit autem Ieremías ad omnem pópulum , et ad univérsas mulíeres :
traditions.KJV: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people , and to all the women ,

24.english_reference: Hear the word of the LORD

traditions.WLC: שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Audíte verbum Dómini
traditions.KJV: Hear the word of the LORD ,

24.english_reference: all Judah that [ are ] in the land of Egypt

traditions.WLC: כָּל יְהוּדָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.VUL: omnis Iuda , qui estis in terra Ægýpti :
traditions.KJV: all Judah that [ are ] in the land of Egypt :

25.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel , saying

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָֽה צְבָאוֹת֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵ אמֹ֗ר

traditions.WLC: אַתֶּ֨ם וּ נְשֵׁי כֶ֜ם וַ תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה בְּ פִי כֶם֮ וּ בִ ידֵי כֶ֣ם מִלֵּאתֶ֣ם לֵ אמֹר֒
traditions.VUL: Vos , et uxóres vestræ locúti estis ore vestro , et mánibus vestris impléstis , dicéntes :
traditions.KJV: Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths , and fulfilled with your hand , saying ,

25.english_reference: We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed , to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her

traditions.WLC: עָשֹׂ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה אֶת נְדָרֵ֗י נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָדַ֨רְנוּ֙ לְ קַטֵּר֙ לִ מְלֶ֣כֶת הַ שָּׁמַ֔יִם וּ לְ הַסֵּ֥ךְ לָ֖ הּ נְסָכִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Faciámus vota nostra , quæ vóvimus , ut sacrificémus regínæ cæli , et libémus ei libámina :
traditions.KJV: We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed , to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her :

25.english_reference: ye will surely accomplish your vows , and surely perform your vows .

traditions.WLC: הָקֵ֤ים תָּקִ֨ימְנָה֙ אֶת נִדְרֵי כֶ֔ם וְ עָשֹׂ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה אֶת נִדְרֵי כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: impléstis vota vestra , et ópere perpetrástis ea .
traditions.KJV: ye will surely accomplish your vows , and surely perform your vows .

traditions.VUL: Ecce ego vigilábo super eos in malum , et non in bonum :
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will watch over them for evil , and not for good :

traditions.WLC: וְ תַמּוּ֩ כָל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם
traditions.VUL: et consuméntur omnes viri Iuda , qui sunt in terra Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: and all the men of Judah that [ are ] in the land of Egypt shall be consumed

27.english_reference: by the sword and by the famine , until there be an end of them .

traditions.KJV: by the sword and by the famine , until there be an end of them .

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלִיטֵ֨י חֶ֜רֶב יְשֻׁב֨וּ ן מִן אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר
traditions.VUL: Et qui fúgerint gládium , reverténtur de terra Ægýpti in terram Iuda viri pauci :
traditions.KJV: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah ,

28.english_reference: and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there

traditions.WLC: וְֽ יָדְע֞וּ כָּל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ בָּאִ֤ים לְ אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לָ ג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et scient omnes relíquiæ Iuda , ingrediéntium terram Ægýpti ut hábitent ibi ,
traditions.KJV: and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there ,

28.english_reference: shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .

traditions.WLC: דְּבַר מִ֥י יָק֖וּם מִמֶּ֥ נִּי וּ מֵ הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: cuius sermo compleátur , meus an illórum .
traditions.KJV: shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .

traditions.WLC: וְ זֹאת לָ כֶ֤ם הָ אוֹת֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Et hoc vobis signum , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: And this [ shall be ] a sign unto you , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי פֹקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עֲלֵי כֶ֖ם בַּ מָּק֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: quod vísitem ego super vos in loco isto :
traditions.KJV: that I will punish you in this place ,

traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ;
